body.Job description: Responsibilities Design and deliver Tableau training sessions for internal team members. Integrate Tableau with Smartsheet using available connectors, APIs, or Data Shuttle. Build interactive dashboards and executive reports. Configure automated data refresh and reporting workflows. Develop reporting standards and dashboard best practices. Train non-technical users on Tableau reporting and analytics. Create documentation, user guides, and training materials. Provide ongoing support and answer questions during implementation. Required Qualifications Strong experience with Tableau dashboard development. Experience working with Smartsheet and Tableau integrations. Knowledge of APIs, Data Shuttle, connectors, or similar integration tools. Understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and report automation. Experience creating executive dashboards and KPI reporting. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Previous experience delivering technical training is preferred. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Preferred Skills Tableau Desktop and Tableau Cloud/Server experience. Smartsheet Control Center or advanced workflow experience. SQL knowledge is a plus. Experience with construction, operations, or project management reporting is a plus. Why Join Smart Build? Flexible remote work schedule. Opportunity to help shape company-wide reporting and analytics. Collaborative and growing team. Make a direct impact on business intelligence and operational reporting.
